SHARED DESIGN LANGUAGE: tokens navy-950 #060a14 / brand-500 #6f47f5 / brand-400 #8a70fb / accent-blue #3b82f6 / accent-cyan #22d3ee, Geist, `grad-text`, `.card`, `.btn-primary`/`.btn-deploy`, `hero-aura`, glass + violet glow; cyan = "live" pop, never amber except warnings. Real imagery/product-screens as centerpiece; asymmetric/editorial layouts (NOT centered-stack); animated "live" elements; compact 5-star review element; the "47 seconds away" speed hook; buying-psychology focus; LESS text MORE presentation. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; mobile-responsive (390w). FORBIDDEN (rejected slop): centered-stack→particle-canvas→3-up-grid skeleton; fake globes (use `components/marketing/NetworkMap`); dead-space cards; text walls. Reusable showcase components in `components/marketing/showcase/` + `DeployCard`, `MatrixTerminal`, `NetworkMap` — reuse/evolve. Game art in `public/games/art/`.

**Template 1 — Server location page (`/preview/location`, component under `components/marketing/locationtemplate/`):** a city/region VPS+game hosting page (do Singapore, Nxeon's real DC). Hero = a stylized network map (use/evolve `NetworkMap`, NOT a globe) or premium city treatment. The distinctive element: an **animated latency visualization** — ping bars/values from Singapore to nearby SEA cities (Jakarta, KL, Manila, Bangkok, HK, Sydney) animating in, telling the "low-latency across Asia" story that's Nxeon's real geo advantage. Add local peering points, the 47s hook, plan cards, compact reviews.

**Template 2 — App/VPS "host X on a VPS" use-case landing (`/preview/app-hosting`, component under `components/marketing/apphostingtemplate/`):** pick a real app (Ghost or Supabase). Anchor on the app's identity (a tasteful representation of its brand/logo — you can render a stylized wordmark/badge; don't fetch external images, the CSP blocks them). Key elements: a **"what you get" spec/requirements table** (RAM/CPU/disk), a **self-host-vs-managed COST comparison table** (the cite-magnet — e.g. "Self-host on Nxeon $X/mo vs Managed cloud $Y/mo"), an **animated deploy terminal** typing the install→live sequence, one-click framing, plan cards, the 47s hook, reviews.

CONCURRENCY CONSTRAINTS (7 agents share this tree): NET-NEW files only; do NOT touch existing live pages/shared components/MarketingHeader/GameLandingPage (READ for reference OK). **Do NOT edit `app/globals.css`** (write race) — put new keyframes/classes in co-located CSS Modules (`*.module.css`) or inline; you may REUSE existing `pv-*` keyframes. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build` and do NOT run a dev server or take screenshots (the main session does one screenshot pass). Report the 2 route paths + concerns.
